legend: A substring of some string is called the most frequent, if the number of its occurrences is not less than number of occurrences of any other substring.

You are given a set of strings. A string (not necessarily from this set) is called good if all elements of the set are the most frequent substrings of this string. Restore the non-empty good string with minimum length. If several such strings exist, restore lexicographically minimum string. If there are no good strings, print "NO" (without quotes).
A substring of a string is a contiguous subsequence of letters in the string. For example, "ab", "c", "abc" are substrings of string "abc", while "ac" is not a substring of that string.
The number of occurrences of a substring in a string is the number of starting positions in the string where the substring occurs. These occurrences could overlap.
String a is lexicographically smaller than string b, if a is a prefix of b, or a has a smaller letter at the first position where a and b differ.
input: The first line contains integer n (1 ≤ n ≤ 105) — the number of strings in the set.
Each of the next n lines contains a non-empty string consisting of lowercase English letters. It is guaranteed that the strings are distinct.
The total length of the strings doesn't exceed 105.
output: Print the non-empty good string with minimum length. If several good strings exist, print lexicographically minimum among them. Print "NO" (without quotes) if there are no good strings.
note: One can show that in the first sample only two good strings with minimum length exist: "cfmailru" and "mailrucf". The first string is lexicographically minimum.

legend.ai: 如果某个字符串的子串出现次数不少于任何其他子串的出现次数，则称该子串为出现次数最多的子串。
给定一个字符串集合。如果一个字符串（不一定属于该集合）的所有子串中，集合中的所有元素都是出现次数最多的子串，则称该字符串是好的。请还原一个长度最小的非空好字符串。如果存在多个这样的字符串，则还原字典序最小的字符串。如果不存在好字符串，输出 "NO"（不含引号）。
字符串的子串是字符串中连续的字母子序列。例如，"ab"、"c"、"abc" 是字符串 "abc" 的子串，而 "ac" 不是该字符串的子串。
一个子串在字符串中的出现次数，是指该子串在字符串中出现的起始位置数量。这些出现可以相互重叠。
如果字符串 a 是字符串 b 的前缀，或者 a 和 b 在第一个不同的位置上 a 的字母更小，则称字符串 a 的字典序小于字符串 b。

input.ai: 第一行包含一个整数 n（1 ≤ n ≤ 105），表示集合中字符串的数量。
接下来的 n 行中，每行包含一个由小写英文字母组成的非空字符串。保证这些字符串互不相同。
字符串的总长度不超过 10^5。

output.ai: 输出长度最小的非空 good 字符串。如果存在多个 good 字符串，输出其中字典序最小的字符串。如果不存在 good 字符串，输出“NO”（不含引号）。

note.ai: 可以证明，在第一个样例中，只有两个长度最小的 good 字符串：“cfmailru”和“mailrucf”。前一个字符串的字典序更小。
